title: Behaviour as Communication
summary: Children communicate their needs through behaviour when they cannot express them in words. Understanding the need beneath the behaviour helps parents respond with connection instead of correction.
cards: Children show needs through actions when they cannot express them verbally.
Understanding the need behind the behaviour changes how you respond.
actions: Ask yourself: 'What is my child trying to communicate?'
Respond to the need, not the behaviour.
reflection: What behaviour is hardest for me to understand?
What need might be underneath that behaviour?
